name: Stoley's Shipment
summary: Stoley is out of rum and asks you to recover his stolen shipment. Captain Cuergo keeps it in Lost Rigger Cove, the walled pirate town to the south.

sections.title: A Stolen Shipment
sections.body: Stoley owes “Sea Wolf” MacKinley of Booty Bay rum for their wager, but his supply is gone. Captain Cuergo took the last shipment and keeps it in Lost Rigger Cove, the walled pirate town to the south. Stoley wants you to bring the rum back so he can prove Kalimdor’s drink is better than anything Booty Bay pours.

sections.title: Where It Is Kept
sections.body: The pirates keep the rum in crates on the upper floor of the house in the northwest.

faq.answer: Stoley is at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. He owes “Sea Wolf” MacKinley in Booty Bay rum to settle their bet.

faq.q: Why does Stoley want his shipment back?
faq.answer: Captain Cuergo stole Stoley’s last rum shipment. Stoley needs it to settle his bet with MacKinley and prove Kalimdor’s booze beats Booty Bay’s.

faq.q: Where did the pirates hide the rum?
faq.answer: The pirates keep the rum in crates on the upper floor of the northwestern house in Lost Rigger Cove, the walled pirate town to the south.
Captain Cuergo stole Stoley’s last rum shipment and keeps it in the walled pirate town to the south.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?

faq.answer: “Sea Wolf” MacKinley is in Booty Bay. He wagered with Stoley over whose rum is better.
